title: Telemetry frame
description: The live cell snapshot every surface renders. Carries command progress so no caller polls for side effects.

pos.description: actual position per axis, in the axis unit

tcp.description: TCP position (m); absent when kinematics are unavailable

workpiece.description: the item the tool carries or has placed; absent until something is grasped

state.description: the cell's declared state — the same set CellSupervisor reports

latched.description: a software e-stop is latched; motion is refused until resume

running.description: the cell is executing something — false when idle AND when faulted, because a fault has stopped, with a reason

accepted_id.description: last command accepted onto the queue

step.description: the program step in flight, e.g. "3/5 pick approach=0.06" — empty/absent when no application is running

app.description: the application file whose steps are running, absent when none is

tcp_quat.description: which way the tool points, as (w, x, y, z) — absent when the cell has no kinematics
